title: GPT-5.2 takes the large-model slot
summary:
GPT-5.2 moved into the large-model routes, two creative community projects joined the listings, and the Pollen checkout buttons returned.

`openai-large` moved from GPT-4.1 to GPT-5.2, and `openai-reasoning` became an alias of the same model. The `openai` route was corrected to GPT-5 Mini, while `openai-fast` remains on GPT-5 Nano. GPT-5.2 also gained a 16,384-token completion cap.

The community listings added @shaqkao1206’s Aqua AI Generator, a Discord bot with reference images, remixing, and configurable generation, and @roni123332’s NextGenTools, which prepares generated and vectorized images for stock submissions.

The $5, $10, $20, and $50 purchase buttons were temporarily disabled, then reconnected to their checkout packs. The temporary balance-panel warning was removed; these changes do not establish a separate fix to how credits are applied.

highlights.title: GPT-5.2 for larger tasks
highlights.text: Use GPT-5.2 through `openai-large` or its `openai-reasoning` alias, with completions up to 16,384 tokens. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-5.2).
